Onna provides targeted collection and management across modern enterprise data sources, including Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, Zoom, Salesforce, ChatGPT and Gemini. Logikcull takes teams through processing, culling, early case assessment, search, review and production in an automated, self-service environment.
